title: George Shearing Trio Paper Moon Music of Nat King Cole CD Telarc Jazz
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
George Shearing Trio - Paper Moon: Music of Nat King Cole (Telarc Jazz CD-83375, 1996). 20-bit digital recording, produced by John Snyder.

George Shearing, piano
Neil Swainson, bass
Louis Stewart, guitar

15 tracks:
1. Straighten Up and Fly Right
2. I'm Lost
3. Sweet Lorraine
4. Nature Boy
5. Homeward Bound
6. I'm Thru With Love
7. It's Only a Paper Moon
8. Gee Baby, Ain't I Good to You
9. Lost April
10. Peaches
11. You've Changed
12. I'd Love To Make Love to You
13. Could Ja
14. I Just Can't See for Lookin'

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
